text:
mira: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. I pasted the action items below — can owners confirm and set target due dates? I'll update the tracker and ping infra if needed.

oncall-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/1779123456 (auto-generated)

sam: I'll take the session-restore race (A1). Planning to have a fix + tests by EOD Fri.

jordan: I'll own runbook + KB updates (A2). Need until next Wed to finish and add reproduction steps. @ops-eng any infra blockers?

ops-eng: infra note: kernel patch required for the hot-restart behavior. We can target Tue change window; opening CHG-1245 now.

tess: I'll handle alert threshold tuning + add e2e test for the alert (A4). ETA Mon.

mira: Thanks. Action summary (short):
- A1: Fix session restore race — owner: sam — due: 2026-03-24
- A2: Runbook + KB + repro steps + telemetry metric for KV misses — owner: jordan — due: 2026-03-26
- A3: Kernel patch / infra change (CHG-1245) — owner: ops-eng — due: 2026-03-23
- A4: Alerts + test coverage — owner: tess — due: 2026-03-22
- A5: Postmortem dashboard + follow-up sync notes — owner: mira — due: 2026-03-29

mira: Please reply with :thumbsup: or propose new dates if these don't work. I'll be the single-point updater for the central issue.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR and link it to the GH issue when ready. Will also add a small integration test.

jordan: +1. I need a short pairing with sam to confirm repro and KV cache traces — @sam what's your window tomorrow?

sam: 9–11am PT works for a quick pairing.

mira: Scheduling 9:30am PT, sending calendar invite to sam/jordan/tess.

ops-eng: CHG-1245 created and assigned. Change window Tue 02:00–04:00 UTC — not blocked currently. I'll post the patch link once CI passes.

tess: Creating alert PR now and tagging eng-sre for review. Will include a test that simulates the spike.

mira: Jordan — can we also add a lightweight telemetry metric for KV cache misses under A2? that'll help validate the fix after deploy.

jordan: Good call. Adding "kv_cache_miss_rate" as a subtask in the runbook.

sam: Noted, I'll emit a trace tag in the fix so we can link errors to sessions.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 5 days — https://redwood.internal/postmortem/1779123456

mira: I'll mark off items as PRs/CHGs land. If anything slips, please @me with a short note (reason + new ETA). Thanks all for the quick responses.

jordan: One last ask — can ops-eng include a short rollback plan in the CHG notes? quick steps if the kernel patch causes regressions.

ops-eng: Will add rollback steps and smoke test checklist in CHG-1245.

tess: Acked. I'll run smoke tests after deploy window and report back in this thread.

sam: I'll link the PR + test results here once merged.

mira: Great. Closing for now — will re-open thread if anything changes. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
